note_en: 受到 + noun gives a passive meaning without 被: "receive, be subjected to." In the text: 北京的雾霾受到了全世界的关注 "Beijing's smog drew (lit. received) the attention of the whole world"; 冒黑烟的小工厂受到了处罚 "the little factory belching black smoke was penalized"; 几只受到保护的江豚 "a few finless porpoises under protection." Unlike 被, there's no need to say who does the action, only that the subject is affected. It sounds formal and turns up a lot in the news.
